verdict.rationale: Composio is presented entirely as a hosted cloud/SaaS platform (sessions, MCP server, CLI, dashboard) with no mention of self-hosting the core service or an open-source deployment option; evidence pack has no self-hosting docs, Docker images, or on-prem deployment guides. Missing for 10: any documentation of self-hosted deployment, open-source repo for the core engine, or on-prem installation instructions.
